profile.headline: Computational Science and Engineering/Software Development
profile.summary: As a seasoned software developer and computational scientist, I specialize in developing performance-critical software for low-latency, high-performance, and high-throughput applications. With decades of experience working on both sides of the research and software development divide, I possess a distinctive capability to tackle complex challenges that span these domains. My expertise is particularly deep in numerical analysis, which is often a fundamental component in performance critical problems. My unique blend of experience and skills enables me to effectively address issues throughout the research-development spectrum, ensuring comprehensive solutions.

positions.title: Computational Fluid Scientist,  HPC Computational Science and Software Development
positions.description:
- Development of a modeling and simulation abstraction system using Clang/LLVM and Racket that includes a declarative DSL based on a comonad notation for the description of PDEs or stencil calculations to facilitate automated application of optimizations over a large variety of wave propagation kernels and hardware architectures.

- Modelling and simulation of turbidity currents for process stratigraphy.
  
- Development of a novel vectorization strategy that eliminates the contention between vectorization and data locality.

- Analysis and optimization of in-house seismic imaging and inversion software.

positions.title: Technical Advisor
positions.description:
-Development of modeling and simulation software for hydraulic fracturing including models for rock deformation, fracture fluid flow and wellbore fluid flow.

-Development of a C++ template library for automatic differentiation (algorithmic differentiation) for use with physical modeling software.

-Development of a framework for the simulation of disparate physical models based on a differential-algebraic system solver that  provides a for a very high level of parallelism, even in tightly coupled systems of equations.

-Development of a graph theoretic algorithm for the generation of index reduction strategies for systems of differential algebraic equations.

-Development of a test harness for modeling and simulation software to prevent the waste associated with the delivery of faulty modeling and simulation software from other business units.

-Web scraping, text mining and natural language processing for evaluation of hydraulic fracturing effectiveness through analysis of public websites and databases, including the use of affix grammars for processing engineering summaries.

-Best practices recommendations for the development of modeling and simulation software.

-Use of Test Driven Design (TDD) for the development of modeling and simulation software.

-Used MatLab, Python and Julia for the development of modeling and simulation prototype software prior to production implementations with C++.

-Agile software methodology for the development of modeling and simulation software.

-Waterfall software methodology for the development of data analytics software.

-Worked as a member of the Advanced Computational Science team.

-Worked as a member of the Software Architecture and Design team.
